lines: Oh! A new face in my studio! Come in, come in, mind the hay.
It was a barn, darling. Now it's a dance studio. The cows moved out years ago, and they were terrible dancers anyway.
Everyone starts somewhere. Stand at the barre, chin up, and point those toes!
String lights for the gazebo? Not in here, darling, I keep mine on the rafters. Try along the street round the green.

rotate: And one, and two, and spin! Lovely! You're a natural.
The disco ball? Friday nights are for disco. Mondays are for ballet. Don't tell anyone, but I prefer Fridays.
The whole town comes to my recital every spring. Even the mayor dances. Badly, but he dances.
Dancing is just walking with a bit more joy in it.
